findings.description: solc-0.4.26 is an outdated solc version. Use a more recent version (at least 0.8.0), if possible.
Version constraint ^0.4.23 contains known severe issues (https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/bugs.html)
Parameter MultiOwnable.newOwner(address)._owner (dataset/contracts/c20.sol#17) is not in mixedCase
Parameter MultiOwnable.deleteOwner(address)._owner (dataset/contracts/c20.sol#23) is not in mixedCase
